Fresh issue: ₹1,200 crore

Total issue: ₹3,412 crore

Bankers: JM Financial Limited, IIFL Capital Services Limited, Kotak Mahindra Capital Company Limited, UBS Securities India Private Limited

Selling shareholders: Nikunj Parashar (₹150 crore); Mridul Babbar (₹180 crore); Lakshay Dang (₹180 crore); Saurabh Avinash Patil (₹160 crore); Ankit Kumar (₹160 crore); Amit Singla (₹40 crore); Manoj Kanhaiyalal Agrawal (₹100 crore); Ramkamalprasad Tribhuwan Singh (₹180 crore); Amish Deepak Desai (₹100 crore); Ankit Deepak Desai (₹100 crore)

Business: We are the only company in India specializing in unmanned, integrated and multi-domain systems across the maritime surface, maritime sub-surface, aerial and land domains (Source: CAREEdge Report). Our platforms are physical vehicles and robotic systems capable of navigating their environment, executing complex missions and making operational decisions without real-time human intervention (Source: CAREEdge Report).

Business: Monomark Engineering (India) Limited (“Monomark” or “MEIL”) is engaged in the business of providing Industrial Operations and Maintenance (“O&M”) services, Metal Fabrication solutions and Industrial Project Execution services to a diversified base of industrial clients across multiple sectors like metals, cement, ports, engineering/original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) to a wide range of industrial and infrastructure clients. DRHP · NLC India Renewables Limited
SEBI · 25 Nov 2026

Fresh issue: ₹3,300 crore
Offer for sale: up to 100,000,000 equity shares of face value ₹10 each, aggregating up to ₹[●] million
Total issue: up to [●] equity shares of face value ₹10 each, aggregating up to ₹[●] million

Bankers: SBI Capital Markets Limited, HDFC Bank Limited, IDBI Capital Markets & Securities Limited, IIFL Capital Services Limited

Selling shareholders: NLC India Limited (up to 100,000,000 shares)

Business: We are a renewable energy company focused on power generation and energy storage. We develop, own and operate renewable energy plants and generate revenue through the sale of power to our offtakers. Our Company is currently a wholly-owned subsidiary of NLC India Limited (one of our Promoters), a ‘Navratna’ Central Public Sector Enterprise (“CPSE”) under the administrative control of the Government of India through the Ministry of Coal. As at October 31, 2026, we had renewable energy power plants/projects and storage solution projects (“Project Portfolio”) with aggregate operational, contracted and awarded capacity (“Operational, Contracted & Awarded Capacity”) of 7,203.96 MW of solar, wind, hybrid and firm and dispatchable renewable energy (“FDRE”) capacity and 3,580.00 MWh of battery energy storage systems (“BESS”) capacity, comprising (i) renewable energy power plants that are operational and in respect of which binding power purchase agreements have been executed with a total capacity (“Operational Capacity”) of 1,783.96 MW of solar and wind capacity, and (ii) renewable energy projects and storage solutions that are not yet operational and in respect of which binding power purchase agreements have been executed or letters of award or letters of intent have been issued to us or which are under construction with an aggregate capacity (“Contracted & Awarded Capacity”) of 5,420.00 MW of solar, wind, hybrid and FDRE capacity and 3,580.00 MWh of BESS capacity.

UDRHP · Swaraj Green Power and Fuel Limited
SEBI · 27 Nov 2026

Fresh issue: ₹800 crore
Offer for sale: ₹300 crore

Bankers: Centrum Capital Limited, InCred Capital Financial Services Limited, PNB Investment Services Limited

Selling shareholders: Ranjeetsingh Hindurao Naik Nimbalkar (₹300 crore)

Business: We are an integrated ethanol production and sugar manufacturing company operating in Satara, Maharashtra. We have established a Manufacturing Facility with an installed sugar crushing capacity of 7,500.00 tonne of cane per day (TCD), a cogeneration unit of 636.00 Megawatt (MW) per day and distillery unit of 500.00 kilo litres per day (KLPD). Our Company generate revenue from sugar manufacturing, distillery operations, electricity (co-generation) and sale of traded goods i.e., sugar.
